description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and functions for virtual network interface support in Zephyr OS, including capabilities, configuration, and attachment mechanisms.

methods.name: net_virtual_interface_attach
methods.description: Attaches or detaches a virtual network interface to/from a physical interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_get_iface
methods.description: Returns the network interface related to a virtual network interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_get_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the virtual network interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_set_name
methods.description: Sets the name of the virtual network interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_set_flags
methods.description: Sets the L2 flags of the virtual network interface and returns previous flags.

methods.name: net_virtual_input
methods.description: Processes incoming IP packets for tunneling support.

methods.name: net_virtual_init
methods.description: Initializes a network interface for virtual interface support.

methods.name: net_virtual_disable
methods.description: Updates carrier state to down for virtual interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_enable
methods.description: Updates carrier state to up for virtual interface.

methods.name: net_virtual_get_iface_capabilities
methods.description: Returns hardware capabilities of the virtual interface.
